rationale: C14 plausibly supplied substantial legal and administrative machinery for the child: assignment of civil-defense functions to a department head, performance through interagency contractual agreements, damage-assessment responsibilities, presidential policy coordination, reservation of Title III emergency authority, redelegation, and treatment of prior emergency-preparedness actions. C12 is also a strong background template, with nearly exact language concerning plans for all national emergencies including attack and the prohibition on putting plans into effect, but it is shorter and less closely matches the child's full operative structure. C03 shares the Civil Defense Act delegation, Title III exclusion, redelegation, and prior-actions machinery, but less of the child's distinctive program language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: He shall utilize to the maximum those capabilities of other agencies qualified to perform or assist in the performance of assigned functions by contractual or other agreements.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: working as necessary or appropriate through other agencies by contractual or other agreements
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared mechanism for performing assigned civil-defense functions through other agencies by contractual or other agreements.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director of the Office of Emergency Planning shall advise and assist the President in determining policy for, and assist him in coordinating the performance of functions under this order with the total national preparedness program.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Director of the Office of Civil and Defense Mobilization shall advise and assist the President in: (i) determining policy for, planning, directing and coordinating ... the total civil defense program
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel presidential policy-advice and program-coordination role.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Maintain a capability to assess the effects of attack on its postal service and resources ... and provide data to the Department of Defense.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: develop plans and operate systems to undertake a nationwide postattack assessment of the nature and extent of the damage resulting from enemy attack and the surviving resources
shared_material.explanation: The child's agency-specific damage-assessment duty adapts C14's nationwide postattack assessment machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Nothing in this order shall be construed as conferring authority under Title III of the Federal Civil Defense Act of 1950 ... Such authority is reserved to the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following functions of the President under the provisions of the Act are excluded from delegations ... and are reserved to the President: ... Title III.
shared_material.explanation: Both expressly reserve the same statutory emergency authority to the President.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Postmaster General is hereby authorized to redelegate within the Post Office Department the functions hereinabove assigned to him.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of Defense is hereby authorized to redelegate within the Department of Defense the functions hereinabove delegated to him.
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim redelegation clause adapted to a different department head.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all conditions of national emergency including attack upon the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: all conditions of national emergency, including attack upon the United States
shared_material.explanation: This exact formulation appears in C12 and supports its position as the second-strongest template source.
